proposed_comments.title: Remove the ColorPicker apphost packaging workaround
proposed_comments.body:
### Remove the ColorPicker apphost packaging workaround

**Severity:** `medium`

The self-contained `ColorPickerUI.UnitTests` executable still project-references the WinExe, so the build emits a ColorPicker apphost into the root output and the installer changes have to regex-strip that incomplete, unsigned copy. Please extract the shared/testable code into a library referenced by both the app and tests, or otherwise remove the Exe-to-WinExe reference so packaging does not rely on a cleanup workaround.

confidence.rationale: The copy button starts success animation and ActionCompleted feedback for every click, while CopyColorText logs TrySetText failure without surfacing the failed result to UI.

proposed_comments.title: Only announce copy success after the clipboard write succeeds
proposed_comments.body:
### Only announce copy success after the clipboard write succeeds

**Severity:** `medium`

The copy button runs the success animation and raises the completion notification for every click even when the bound copy command fails. `ColorEditorViewModel.CopyColorText` logs when `TrySetText` returns false, but that result is not propagated back to the control, so users and screen-reader users can be told the color was copied when the clipboard was not updated. Please propagate the copy result and only show/announce success after a successful write, with failure feedback otherwise.
